commands.summary: Add or remove the active tab's URL from bookmarks.
commands.availability: The active tab has a bookmarkable URL.

commands.summary: Navigate the active tab to its previous entry.
commands.availability: The active tab has a previous navigation entry.

commands.summary: Open developer tools attached to the active tab.
commands.availability: The active tab hosts a debuggable target and policy permits it.

commands.summary: Dismiss the find bar and clear the native find selection.
commands.availability: The active tab has a find session.

commands.summary: Advance to the next match in the active tab's find session.
commands.availability: The active tab has a find session.

commands.summary: Open the native find bar for the active tab and focus its input.
commands.availability: The active tab hosts findable contents.

commands.summary: Return to the previous match in the active tab's find session.
commands.availability: The active tab has a find session.

commands.summary: Navigate the active tab to its next entry.
commands.availability: The active tab has a forward navigation entry.

commands.summary: Open Chromium's save-page picker for the active tab.
commands.availability: The active tab hosts a savable scheme and policy permits it.

commands.summary: Open Chromium's print preview for the active tab.
commands.availability: The active tab hosts printable contents and policy permits it.

commands.summary: Reload the active tab, or stop a load in progress.
commands.availability: A tab is active.

commands.summary: Open the view-source document for the active tab's current entry.
commands.availability: The active tab has a navigation entry on a viewable scheme.

commands.summary: Increase the active tab's zoom to the next native level.
commands.availability: The active tab is below Chromium's maximum zoom level.

commands.summary: Decrease the active tab's zoom to the previous native level.
commands.availability: The active tab is above Chromium's minimum zoom level.

commands.summary: Return the active tab's origin to the profile default zoom level.
commands.availability: The active tab's origin has a zoom level set.

commands.summary: Close the target tab and activate an adjacent one.
commands.availability: A closable tab is targeted.

commands.summary: Open a copy of the target tab beside it.
commands.availability: A tab is targeted.

commands.summary: Group the selected tabs using Chromium's native tab groups.
commands.availability: At least one tab is selected.

commands.summary: Remove the selected tabs from their group without closing them.
commands.availability: Every selected tab belongs to a group.

commands.summary: Open a New Tab Page in the active window.
commands.availability: A browser window is open.

commands.summary: Retire a workspace, transferring every one of its tabs at once.
commands.availability: A second workspace exists in the same profile to receive the tabs.

commands.summary: Create an empty workspace in the active profile with a New Tab.
commands.availability: A profile is active.

commands.summary: Project the selected workspace and restore its last active tab.
commands.availability: The selected workspace exists in the window's profile.

commands.summary: Transfer tabs to another workspace while keeping their native state.
commands.availability: The destination workspace exists in the same profile.
